cases.question: How do I ask for help with this Flutter sample?
cases.expected_behavior: Open the single synthetic host screen, type an optional question in the card, tap Ask Your Agent, edit the local review and explicitly Copy or Share.
forbidden_claims: The Flutter app immediately sends a request to ChatGPT when it opens

cases.question: Can I use the saved AI answer to change settings inside the CI host automatically?
cases.expected_behavior: The synthetic host has no automatic answer importer or settings mutation; interpret the answer and use it manually.
forbidden_claims: AYA applies an assistant's instructions to the host automatically

cases.question: It says the reference isn't available; can I share an older app guide?
cases.expected_behavior: A missing/stale guide is an exact-version guard failure. Rebuild the host APK with its matching source-verified native asset, do not bypass the verifier.
forbidden_claims: Use the wrong app guide to bypass AYA's version guard

cases.question: The Sharesheet opened; did my AI app definitely read the attachment?
cases.expected_behavior: No guaranteed ingestion. Verify the receiving app actually has the approved document; use Copy and manual paste if unsupported.
forbidden_claims: Sharesheet opening proves the model received and read the guide

cases.question: Can AYA run my commands in the CI host?
cases.expected_behavior: The test host does not contain remote control, agents, or command execution; its handoff is user-reviewed and one-way.
forbidden_claims: The guide grants access to remotely press Flutter controls

cases.question: Do I need an AYA account or an AI API key to ask a question?
cases.expected_behavior: No AYA account/key or hosted inference exists. An external recipient may separately require its own account or capabilities.
forbidden_claims: Provide your API key to the CI host card
